content: Jerusalenman Jesus yaycuptin runacuna cushicur chasquicuyangan
Tsaypita Jerusalenman yaycuraycarnam chäyargan “Olivos” ningan jircanman. Tsay jircan wac-wagtanchömi Betfage y Betania marcacuna cargan. Tsaypitam Jesus cachargan ishcay discïpuluncunata caynö nir:
“Aywayay tagay wac-tsimpapa. Tsaychömi tariyanqui manarä pipis muntacushga juc pollïnu ashnu wataraycagta. Tsayta pascasquir apayämunqui.
Pipis ‘¿Imapätä tsay ashnuta apayanqui?’ niyäshuptiquega niyanqui: ‘Señor Jesusmi miñishtin muntacunanpä. Rätupayllatam cutiratsiyämushä’ nir”.
Tsaynam ishcan discïpuluncuna aywar tariyargan Jesus ningannölla wayi puncu näni cagchö ashnu wataraycagta.
Tsayta pascaycäyagta ricaycurnam runacuna tapuyargan: “¿Imapätä cay ashnuta pascayanqui?”
Niyaptin discïpuluncunanam niyargan Jesus yätsingannölla. Tsaynam runacuna dejaycuyargan discïpuluncuna apayänanpä.
Jesus caycangan cagman chäratsiyaptinnam punchuncunata carunaparcuyaptin Jesus muntacurgan.
Tsaynö muntashga aywaraycaptinnam runacuna punchuncunata jacuncunata näniman mashtayargan. Waquincunanam jachapa rämancunata paquiscärir mashtayargan Jesus aywangan näniman.
Nircurnam llapan runacuna Jesuspa ñöpanta gepanta aywar cushicuypita gayaraypa gayarar niyargan:

content.text: “¡Tayta Dios cachamungan mandamagllantsic rey alabashga caycullätsun!
¡Unay David rey cangan watacunachönömi cananga gamna mandayämag reylläcuna canqui!

content: Tsaypita Jerusalenman Jesus chaycurnam templuman aywargan. Tsaychö ricapacusquirnam tardiyaptinna Betaniaman cuticurgan discïpuluncunawan.
Hïguspa yuran tsaquinanpä Jesus ningan
Tsaypita warayninnam Betaniapita aywaraycarna Jesus mallagacuycurgan.
Tsaynam ricasquirgan hïguspa yuran verdirä caycämogta. Tsaynöta ricarnam prütanta pallag aywargan. Peru yuranllatam tarirgan manarä hïguspa tiempun captin.
Tsaynam discïpuluncunapa wiyananchö hïguspa yuranta Jesus nirgan: “Cananpita manam pipis prütayquita micunganatsu” nir.
Templupita ranticogcunata Jesus gargungan

Jesus Jerusalenman chaycurnam templuman yaycurgan. Tsaychö ranticogcunata y rantipacogcunata tariycurnam gargur ushargan. Gellë trocatsegcunapa mësancunatapis, paluma ranticogcunapa jamacuyänancunatapis wicaparmi ushargan.
Nircur micharganmi templupa puncun quinran rantipacuynincunata puritsiyänantapis.

Tsaycunata rurasquirnam runacunata ajäpar nirgan: “Tayta Diospa palabranchö caynömi gellgaraycan: ‘Temploga noga Diosllayquita maytsaypitapis shamur adorayämänayquipämi’ nir. Tsaynö nicaptinga ¿imanirtä gamcunaga ladroncunapa machaynintanö catsiyanqui?” nir.

Tsaynö Jesus rurangancunata musyarnam sacerdöticunapa mandagnincuna y ley yachatsicogcuna willanacuyargan wanutsiyänanpä. Peru Jesuspa yachatsicuynincuna runacunapä alläpa alli captinmi paycunata mantsar dejaycuyarganrä.
Tsaypita patsa tsacanaptinnam Jerusalenpita Jesusga discïpuluncunawan aywacuyargan.
Hïguspa yuran tsaquishgatana ricayangan
Waraynin Jerusalenman cutiraycarnam Jesus manana wayunanpä ningan hïguspa yuran matsunpita tsaquishga caycagta discïpuluncuna ricayargan.
Tsayta ricaycurnam Pedro yarpasquir Jesusta nirgan: “¡Taytay, ricaycuy! Ganyan tagay hïgusta ‘Mananam wayunquinatsu’ ningayqui tsaquishgana caycan” nir.
Niptinnam Jesus nirgan: “Tayta Diosman yäracuyay.
Pipis payman yäracur tagay jircata ‘Tsaypita lamarman witicuriy’ niyaptiquipis witicurinmanmi.
Gamcuna Tayta Diosman yäracuycur mañacurnin imatapis mañacuyangayquitaga alcanzayanquim.
Tayta Diosman mañacuyangayqui öra pipis mana alli ricäyäshogcunapä yarpar perdonayanqui. Tsaynöpam gamcunatapis Tayta Dios perdonayäshunqui llapan jutsayquicunapita.
[Gamcuna perdonacuyta mana yachayaptiquega Tayta Dios manam gamcunatapis perdonayäshunquitsu]”.
Jesus templupita imanir runacunata gargunganta autoridäcuna tapupäyangan

Tsaynam Jesus discïpuluncunawan yapayna Jerusalenman chäriyargan. Templuchö Jesus puriraycaptinnam sacerdöticunapa mandagnincuna, ley yachatsicogcuna, y mas waquin autoridäcuna aywar tapuyargan caynö:
“Gam ¿ima puëdeg cayniquiwantä cay templupita ranticogcunata gargurguyqui? Tsaycunata ruranayquipä ¿pitä cachamushurguyqui?” nirnin.

Tsaynö niyaptinnam Jesus nirgan: “Gamcunatapis mä jucta tapuyäshayqui. ¿Pitä Juanta cachamurgan bautizananpä? ¿Tayta Dioscu o runacunacu? Tapungäta niyämaptiquega nogapis willayäshayquim tsaynö ruranäpä pï cachamangantapis”.
Tsaynö niptinnam quiquincuna pura willanacur niyargan: “‘Tayta Diosmi cachamushga’ nishgaga nimäshun ‘¿Imanirtä payta chasquicuyargayquitsu?’ nirmi.
‘Runacunallam cachamushga’ nishganam llapan runacuna janantsicman shayämunga. Paycunaga Tayta Dios Juan Bautistata cachamungantam yarpäyan”.

Tsaynö willanacurirnam Jesusta niyargan: “Nogacuna manam musyayätsu Juanta pï cachamungantapis”. Tsaynö niyaptinnam Jesus nirgan: “Gamcunapis mana willaycäyämaptiquega nogapis manam willätsu caycunata ruranäpä pï cachamangantapis”.
